name: math30
description: Math-heavy pretraining mix for the reasoning objective: 30% of tokens are mathematics, against 15% in the `quality` profile. The increase is paid for out of web, which drops from 60% to 42% and keeps only the educationally filtered and deduplicated corpus plus a small raw-FineWeb anchor for general language. Within math, the budget favours worked solutions over statements: `openmath_instruct` and the generated `math_drills` corpus both show the arithmetic being carried out step by step, which is the behaviour the post-training stages have to elicit and cannot teach from scratch. `math_drills` is capped at 6% and `deepmind_math` at 5% so templated synthetic text stays a minority of the math budget; the rest is natural mathematical prose, which is what keeps the model able to read a problem it has not seen phrased that way before.
